title: Wave 8 Physics Domain Adapter Feature Matrix
governing_rules: Physics adapts to the kernel; the kernel does not adapt to physics

features: PhysicalObjective with target observables, precision tolerance, parameter space, and conservation constraints
MeasuredObservation with sensor metadata, projection matrices P, observable values, and measurement noise variance
PhysicalHypothesis with model parameters, latent coordinates, null-space dimension, and empirical status
PhysicalConstraint with conservation laws (Energy, Momentum, Flux, Symplectic Invariance)
EpistemicStatus tracking 5-level hierarchy: OBSERVED -> INFERRED -> MODEL_CONSISTENT -> FALSIFICATION_SURVIVED -> MEASUREMENT_SUPPORTED
Strict prohibition of source identification when null-space dimension > 0
LatentGeneratorInverter consuming representation-neutral PSMSL InverseProjection substrate
Exact recovery of minimum-norm generator representative X_hat
Exact null-space basis identification spanning ker(P)
Observational equivalence class verification: Sigma(X1) == Sigma(X2) under projection P
Strict non-identifiability enforcement: null space > 0 implies AMBIGUOUS and source_identified = False
Discrete Kalman observability matrix construction and rank tracking across rotating projections
PhysicalCertificationBoundary implementing the 5-Gate physical admissibility chain C_phys = { D, C, M, F, R }
Gate D (Dimensional Consistency): rejects dimensional unit mismatches
Gate C (Conservation Constraints): rejects non-conservative physical models fail-closed
Gate M (Measurement Agreement): evaluates residual error against empirical observation within tolerance
Gate F (Falsifier Survival): rejects over-fitting degrees of freedom and unwarranted source identification
Gate R (Repeatability / Replay): verifies invariance across independent sensor batches
Zero empirical observations restricted to THEORETICALLY_ADMISSIBLE, never promoted to MEASUREMENT_SUPPORTED
PhysicalGrammarFactorer enforcing literal frozen 6D coordinates (Delta, I, W, sigma, Pi, Gamma) + circ
Conservation constraints mapped to coordinate I
Empirical witness certificates registered to coordinate W with Delta d = 0
Sensor projection operators mapped to coordinate Pi
Observable signatures mapped to coordinate sigma
Strict detection and fail-closed rejection of semantic drift and ungrounded heuristic tokens
PhysicsAdapter implementing canonical domain adapter contract
required_work(objective) -> WorkContract
candidate_machinery(deficiency, state) -> list[MachineryNode]
infer_latent_generator(observations) -> LatentInferenceResult
factor_grammar(work) -> FactoringAuditRecord
certify(result, observations, constraints) -> PhysicalCertificate | CertificationResult
measure_ability(objective, state) -> float
